belongs_to: Figure it Out (book pp. 41-42) Q4: "Find out the sum of the numbers given in each picture below in at least two different ways. Describe how you solved it through expressions." - picture (I)
description: Picture labelled (I) (label printed below the picture, left of picture II). A 3 x 3 arrangement of 9 numbered shapes, evenly spaced, no grid lines, plain white background. Row 1 (top): yellow square with 4, blue circle with 8, yellow square with 4. Row 2: blue circle with 8, yellow square with 4, blue circle with 8. Row 3 (bottom): yellow square with 4, blue circle with 8, yellow square with 4. So the 4 corners and the centre are yellow squares carrying 4 (5 squares, each 4); the 4 edge-middle positions are blue circles carrying 8 (4 circles, each 8). Total shapes = 9; sum = 5 x 4 + 4 x 8 = 52. Numbers are printed in black, centred in each shape; the shapes are slightly different in size (squares a little smaller than circles). The caption '(I)' sits centred below the picture and is not part of the figure.

belongs_to: Figure it Out (book pp. 41-42) Q4: "Find out the sum of the numbers given in each picture below in at least two different ways. Describe how you solved it through expressions." - picture (II)
description: Picture labelled (II) (label printed below the picture, right of picture I). A 4 x 4 arrangement of 16 numbered circles, evenly spaced, no grid lines, plain white background. Blue circles carry 5, red (pink-red) circles carry 6. Row 1 (top): blue 5, red 6, red 6, blue 5. Row 2: red 6, blue 5, blue 5, red 6. Row 3: red 6, blue 5, blue 5, red 6. Row 4 (bottom): blue 5, red 6, red 6, blue 5. So the 4 corner circles and the central 2 x 2 block are blue with 5 (8 circles of 5); the 8 remaining edge circles (two in the middle of each side) are red with 6 (8 circles of 6). Total circles = 16; sum = 8 x 5 + 8 x 6 = 88. Numbers are printed in black, centred in each circle. The caption '(II)' sits centred below the picture and is not part of the figure.
